text.p: Following are the reports carried by Estonia's newspapers on Monday. Reuters has not verified these reports and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- A two-motor plane drove 38 metres off the strip when landing at Tallinn airport on Saturday. Nobody was injured in the incident.
- The government residence at Toompea castle received a bomb threat on Saturday. A search uncovered no bombs.
- Electoral union Tallinn is prepared to leave the post of the Mayor of Tallinn to the Reform Party, and wants the post of the council chairman to itself, leader Robert Lepikson says.
- Election results in Rae district may be declared invalid because of several irregularities, including voting in a pub, the local election commission said.
- Customs officials in Tallinn have seized 700,000 litres of illicit alcohol this year.
- Law and order has not been a priority in Estonia, Interior Minister Mart Rask said in an interview.
